description: Give the signed-in user a ONE-TAP link that opens tulugar.com already logged in to their account — no code, no password. Use when a WhatsApp user needs the website: upload photos, finish a listing in the wizard, manage their account. The link is single-use and expires in 10 minutes; share it verbatim. Only works for accounts with a verified WhatsApp number.

return_to.description: Optional site path to land on (e.g. "/es/account/listings"). Defaults to the account home.

name: open_web_session
title: Open Signed-in Web Session
